distribution: Baishanzu, Qingyuan, Zhejiang, about 1,050 m a.s.l.
soldier: Soldier head capsule pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the head surface very sparsely haired. The head capsule is rectangular, the lateral margins parallel to each other, slightly narrowed at the middle, the posterior margin forming a straight line. The frontal region is slightly raised, the depression between the two frontal ridges shallow. The labrum is bluntly spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, with apical, subapical and fine short lateral-apical hairs all present. The mandibles are short and stout, their apices very strongly curved; the antennae consist of 15 segments. The anterior broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-sixth, the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel. The anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum are both nearly straight, the notch of the anterior margin wider and deeper than that of the posterior, the lateral margins nearly straight and slowly narrowing posteriorly. About eight long hairs grow in the middle region, interspersed with several short hairs.
